summary: Baosheng Media Group filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market issuance of up to US$30 million of ordinary shares to High West Partners LLC, plus US$300,000 in commitment shares. The purchase price is formula-based with no stated fixed price per share, premium, or close date. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) to raise capital, not a special situation. There are no merger, tender, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The terms are purely mechanical for ongoing financing.
